parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood, providing rigidity and support for other parts.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the door, drawer, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that holds other components in place.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a stable foundation for the cabinet and distributes weight evenly to the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a hinged wooden panel that covers the storage compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space and protects contents from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding wooden compartment located at the top of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides accessible storage for smaller items and can be pulled out for use.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along rails or runners.
